records.text: Jon lost his job as a banker on January 19, 2023, and decided to try starting his own business.
Gina said she had lost her job at DoorDash during January 2023.
Jon plans to start a dance studio because dancing has been his passion and escape since childhood, and he wants to teach others the joy it brings him.
Jon loves all dance styles, with contemporary dance as his top choice because he finds it expressive and powerful.
Gina enjoys dancing as a way to relieve stress and especially likes contemporary dance, which she finds expressive and graceful.
Jon and Gina agreed to meet for a dance session on Friday, January 27, 2023, to explore dance moves; Jon said Gina could see his moves.
Jon shared a photograph showing a man in a suit performing a dance; the man's identity was not specified.
In 2022, Jon’s dance crew won first place in a local dance competition. Jon said performing on the stage was amazing and that he was keen to share that intensity with other people.

Gina said she had competed in several dance competitions and shows. Her favorite memory was winning first place with her team at a regional competition when she was fifteen; she described it as an awesome feeling of accomplishment. Gina shared a photo showing a couple of people standing next to each other.

Gina’s team performed a contemporary dance piece called “Finding Freedom” at the regional competition Gina recalled. Gina described the piece as emotional and powerful. Gina also shared a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water.

Jon showed Gina his ideal dance studio: a room with an ocean view and several yoga mats. Jon hoped to find a place like it that would inspire them. Gina praised the setup and the view and asked whether Jon had time to rehearse while dealing with a business and a new store.

Jon said he rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. The group practiced various styles, including contemporary and hip-hop, and was finishing choreography for a performance at a nearby festival the following month. Jon shared a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage.

Jon confirmed that the dancers shown in the photo of dancers in white dresses onstage were the group performing at the nearby festival in February 2023. Jon said they had been practicing hard and would impress with their grace and skill; Gina said she looked forward to seeing them perform.

On 2023-01-29, Gina said she had launched an advertising campaign for her clothing store to grow the business. Gina described starting the store and taking risks as both scary and rewarding, and said she was excited to see what would happen.
On 2023-01-29, Gina shared a photo showing a clothing store with a variety of clothes on display.
On 2023-01-29, Jon complimented Gina's clothing store and said her hard work had paid off; he thought it must be great to see her merchandise on display.

As of 2023-01-29, Jon was searching for a location for his planned dance studio. He had viewed different places and found a downtown location with good natural light, but still needed to assess the space's size and floor quality. He wanted a safe dance floor with enough bounce for himself and his students.

On 2023-01-29, Jon said he had visited Paris the previous day, 2023-01-28. He shared a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall; the conversation did not explicitly establish that the photographed bathroom was in Paris.
Gina said on 2023-01-29 that she had visited Rome once and had never had a chance to visit Paris.

As of 2023-01-29, Jon wanted Marley flooring for his dance studio. He valued its grip while allowing movement, durability, and ease of cleaning, and said dance flooring should help students dance safely.
On 2023-01-29, Gina agreed that Marley flooring was suitable because it provided an appropriate balance of grip and movement, and said she looked forward to seeing Jon's completed dance studio.
On 2023-01-29, Jon described finding a place and preparing his dance studio as exciting but nerve-wracking. He was determined to make the project work and believed the effort would be worthwhile.

On 2023-01-29, Gina encouraged Jon through the challenges of establishing his dance studio, told him to believe in himself, and suggested taking breaks and dancing to relieve stress. Jon said he was glad to have Gina's support and agreed that he should make time to dance and vent.
On 2023-01-29, Gina and Jon encouraged one another to keep pursuing their goals and dreams. They expressed optimism that good things and success were ahead.
As of 2023-02-01, Jon was still looking for a place to open his dance studio. Jon said pursuing dance had been bumpy but he was determined to make it work.

On 2023-02-01, Gina said she had emailed wholesalers and one wholesaler had replied yes that day. Gina was over the moon because this would let her expand her clothing store and get closer to her customers.

On 2023-02-01, Gina shared a photo depicting a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign. Gina presented it while discussing the opportunity to expand her clothing store; the sign's text and the precise relationship of the pictured mall to her store were not specified.

On 2023-02-01, Jon praised Gina for finding a place for her store and shared a photo of a room with a mirror and wooden floor. Jon described it as the perfect spot for Gina's store, though the image's exact location and purpose were not established.

On 2023-02-01, Gina said the place was a great spot and shared a photo of a clothing store with many clothes on display. Gina described the pictured space as one she had designed to feel cozy and inviting, where customers could browse trendy pieces.

On 2023-02-01, Gina said she had spent time designing her clothing store to reflect her personal style and make customers feel cozy. She chose furniture that was attractive and comfortable, and added a chandelier for a glamorous feel that matched the store’s style.
On 2023-02-01, Gina said she wanted her clothing store to feel comfortable and inviting, like a cool oasis, and to create a special shopping experience that would make customers want to return.
On 2023-02-01, Jon praised Gina’s store design and her goal of making customers comfortable and welcomed, saying he believed she could create the space she imagined.

On 2023-02-01, Gina said creating a special shopping experience was tough but that she was ready for the challenge and would work hard. Gina told Jon to stay positive and keep going with his dance studio; Jon said he was staying positive and pushing forward, and that they had put their hearts into their dreams and would make it.
On 2023-02-04, Gina said her clothing store was doing great, though running it was a wild ride.
On 2023-02-04, Jon said that finding a location for his planned dance studio was tricky, but he remained determined to find the right place and believed the rest of his business would follow.

On 2023-02-04, Jon said he was working on his business and new dance routines and rehearsing hard for an upcoming show. He said dancing brought him joy and fulfillment. Jon shared a photo showing a woman in a gray dress performing a trick.
On 2023-02-04, Jon said he was preparing for a dance competition near him in March 2023 and was excited about showing his skills and earning recognition from the dance community.

On 2023-02-04, Gina encouraged Jon through setbacks in his business and dance plans, told him she fully supported him and would always be there for him, and urged him not to give up. Jon said Gina's support meant a lot and helped him feel able to handle difficulties.

On 2023-02-08, Gina told Jon she had found a new fashion piece for her clothing store and was excited to share it with customers. The accompanying photo showed a group of women posing with a giant balloon.

On 2023-02-08, Jon told Gina that he had performed at a festival he had previously mentioned. He said the performance was awesome, many people complimented his dance moves, and dancing brought him joy and reminded him why he was passionate about it. The accompanying photo showed a group of young girls in a dance studio.

On 2023-02-08, Jon said he loved running his own dance studio. He valued the freedom to create a space where dancers of all ages and skill levels could express themselves, and found it fulfilling to dance every day and see his students progress.
On 2023-02-08, Gina said she had been working hard on her online store and had teamed up with a local artist to create designs. She showed Jon a photo of a clothing rack holding a coat and a dress.

Gina said she got the idea for her clothing designs from a fashion magazine and noticed that similar items were not widely available. She worked with a local artist to bring the designs to life, aiming to stay ahead of trends and offer customers something different.
Gina said taking risks is scary but necessary for growth and part of the journey to success. Jon agreed that taking risks is key to success and said doing so had helped him grow.

On 2023-02-08, Jon said he had left his secure 9-to-5 banker job to pursue turning his passion for dance into a business. He was determined to make his dance business work, while acknowledging that starting it had been difficult and not a walk in the park.

On 2023-02-08, Gina encouraged Jon not to be discouraged by the difficulty of starting his dance business, said she believed he could make his studio work, and assured him she was there for him. Jon said her help meant a lot and that he would keep working and stay optimistic.

On 2023-02-08, Jon shared a photograph of a cartoon character with a quote about fear. Gina said the quote had kept her positive through tough times and that she had even gotten a tattoo to remind herself of it. Gina also shared a photograph showing a woman standing on a balcony wearing a blue dress; the conversation does not specify whether the tattoo or quote is visible in that photo.

Gina said on 2023-02-08 that she got her tattoo a few years earlier. The tattoo represents freedom—dancing without worrying what people think—and reminds Gina to follow her passions and express herself.
Jon said on 2023-02-08 that dance gives him an escape where he can be himself, and agreed with Gina that people should be free to express themselves without worry.
Jon shared a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture.
Gina told Jon that his dedication to his dance studio inspired her and encouraged him to pursue his dreams. Jon said Gina's support meant a lot and that he appreciated having her in his corner.
Jon shared a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top. The conversation did not specify what the trophy was for.

Jon said that juggling dance and business goals was challenging but rewarding. He said dance energized him to work on business goals, while business successes boosted his motivation on the dance floor; he described the balance as fun.

Jon said he would keep working hard on his dance studio and business ventures and would not give up on his dreams. Gina said she would continue supporting Jon and that they should keep moving forward while helping each other pursue their dreams.
Jon started going to the gym during the week of 2023-03-06 to stay on track with his venture. Jon said he had been busy, was figuring out how to balance everything, and that things were going well.
On 2023-03-16, Gina said she had been having a tough time since losing her job at DoorDash.
On 2023-03-16, Gina told Jon she had good news to share, but did not reveal what it was in this conversation segment. Jon responded enthusiastically and said he could not wait to hear it.

On 2023-03-16, Gina announced that her online clothes store had opened, saying she had dreamed of it for a while and was excited to see what would happen. Gina shared a photo of a computer screen showing a book and a pair of shoes.
Gina said she started her online clothes store because she is passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces, and wanted to blend her love of dance with her love of fashion.
On 2023-03-16, Jon congratulated Gina on opening her online clothes store and shared a photo of three young girls standing next to each other with trophies.

On 2023-03-16, Jon said that losing his job had been hard and starting his business had been tough, with new challenges, but he was living his dreams and believed his efforts would be worth it. Jon shared a photo of a laptop sitting on a table.
On 2023-03-16, Gina said that starting and running her own business had had ups and downs but had been an amazing ride.
On 2023-03-16, Jon said Gina's success and determination inspired him to keep pushing forward; Gina was glad that her journey inspired others and said Jon's words encouraged her.

On 2023-03-16, Gina and Jon expressed mutual support as fellow business owners pursuing different paths. They encouraged each other to keep chasing their dreams, face challenges, celebrate achievements, and work toward success together. Jon described their shared challenges as motivating and like having a partner to dance with, and thanked Gina for having his back. Jon shared a photo of two glasses of champagne with a bottle of wine in the background.

On 2023-03-23, Gina said her online clothing store had been a roller coaster but rewarding; she was keeping up with fashion trends to offer customers the best pieces, found the work demanding, and was enjoying it.

On 2023-03-23, Jon told Gina that pursuing his business had been tough but he was determined to make it happen. He praised Gina's store, and Gina encouraged him to hang in there as starting a business takes courage.
On 2023-03-23, Gina asked Jon for advice or tips on running a successful business; Jon had not yet given advice in this conversation segment.

On 2023-03-23, Jon advised Gina that her store’s brand identity should stand out, that she should build relationships with customers by showing them she cares, and that staying positive and motivating others could spread her energy.
records.topic: Gina's store branding and customer relationships

records.text: On 2023-03-23, Gina said she was continually working on building customer relationships and creating a strong brand image for her store, and agreed that staying positive was important.
Jon said that seeing his dance students succeed and helping them learn and reach their goals motivated him in his dance studio business. He added that Gina's support meant a lot to him.
On 2023-03-23, Jon shared a photo taken after a dance class. The photo showed a group of women doing a dance routine.

On 2023-03-23, Gina praised Jon's students' growth and success and said she was glad to be part of his journey. Gina repeatedly encouraged and supported Jon, telling him she was rooting for him and urging him not to give up. Jon repeatedly thanked Gina, said her help made a huge difference and helped him stay motivated, and said her words motivated him to keep going and believe in himself.

On 2023-04-03, Jon told Gina that he had shut down his bank account because he believed doing so would help his dance business grow. Jon said the decision was tough and adapting to changes had been hard, but he was staying positive and looking ahead.

On 2023-04-03, Gina said she had introduced new offers and promotions in her online clothing store to attract customers. She described starting the business as a wild ride but said she was not giving up.
Gina said dance helps relieve her stress, fashion fuels her creativity, and discovering new trends for her store keeps her motivated to grow the business.
On 2023-04-03, Gina shared a photo of a man and a woman doing a yoga pose, which she described as a picture from her favorite dance session.

Gina said she combines her clothing business with dance because she is passionate about both and wants to express her creativity and share her interests. She also plans to add dance-inspired items to her store.

On 2023-04-03, Gina said customers liked her online store's new offers and promotions, sales were increasing, and customers seemed to like her designs. She was seeking unique, trendy pieces and said growing the store's customer base was her main focus.

Gina was considering collaborating with fashion bloggers and influencers in the coming months and planned to run more advertisements to reach potential customers. She wanted to build her customer base and make her online store a top destination for fashion fans.

Jon was expanding his dance studio's social media presence and offering workshops and classes to local schools and centers. He planned to host a dance competition in May 2023 to showcase local talent and draw attention to the studio.

Jon said his dance studio's efforts were paying off: he was seeing progress, the dancers were excited, and he felt good about providing a place where people could express themselves through dance. He also said making his plan work had been tough and Gina's encouragement helped him.

Jon invited Gina to a dance event planned for May 2023. The event would feature Jon's dance studio and other schools presenting performances and having their dancing judged; Gina said she would like to attend and show her support.
On 2023-04-03, Jon shared a photo of a group of people on a stage with a projector screen, followed by a photo of a group of dancers on a stage with a man in the middle of the group.
On 2023-04-03, Gina confirmed she would attend Jon’s show and said she looked forward to seeing him at the event.

On 2023-04-03, Gina shared a photo of a woman posing in a tutu. Jon shared a photo of two women doing a handstand in a room, and Gina shared a photo of a group of young girls wearing tutus and ballet shoes.
On 2023-04-03, Jon wished Gina good luck with her store and shared a photo of a dress beside a sign reading “june bunty.” Gina thanked Jon and said she appreciated his kind words.

On 2023-04-03, Jon told Gina he was always there for her. Gina said his support meant a lot and that she would keep pursuing her goals, while hoping Jon would pursue his. Jon said he would not give up on his dreams and that Gina’s words motivated him.
On 2023-04-03, Jon shared a photo of a street light on a sidewalk in front of a building. Gina and Jon exchanged goodbyes; Gina encouraged Jon to believe in himself, keep pushing, and take care.

On 2023-04-09, Jon told Gina he was putting extensive time into his dance studio business, that his students were already doing well, and that he was learning alongside them. Jon shared a photo of a group of dancers performing on a stage with a red background.
On 2023-04-09, Gina praised Jon for turning his passion for dance into a business and said his dance studio looked awesome. Gina shared a photo showing a dress display and a flamingo.
On 2023-04-09, Jon said losing his job had been tough but had pushed him to pursue what he loved and make his dance studio work.
On 2023-04-09, Gina told Jon that difficult times can lead to good opportunities and praised his courage in pursuing his dreams. Gina shared a photo of a red dress with gold accents on a mannequin.

On 2023-04-09, Jon said dancing makes him very happy, lets him share that happiness with other people, and that seeing his students improve brings him joy. Jon shared a photo of a woman pole dancing in a dance studio.
On 2023-04-09, Gina told Jon he looked happy when dancing and encouraged him to show the world his true self and keep dancing.

On 2023-04-09, Jon described dance as a way to express himself and find his happy place. He said he used to be very afraid of others' opinions, but learned that his own happiness matters most; pursuing dance had been difficult but was the best thing ever for him.

On 2023-04-09, Gina recalled taking dance classes and spending time in a studio; she said a photo Jon shared brought back memories and that dance remained his happy place. Gina shared a photo of a group of young women wearing ballet attire.

On 2023-04-09, Jon said dance held special meaning for both him and Gina as a form of self-expression. He fondly remembered taking dance lessons with friends when he was younger and was glad he could still enjoy dance through his own studio. Jon thanked Gina for being there for him.

On 2023-04-09, Gina said dance helps with self-expression and happiness. She shared a photo of a dance-contest trophy topped with a glass globe, describing it as a reminder of the hard work, dedication, and joy involved.

On 2023-04-09, Jon thanked Gina for her support and said something looked awesome; Gina replied that Jon had earned kudos for his hard work. Jon said he would keep pushing and working hard and would not let anything hold him back. Gina encouraged Jon, saying he was almost there.

On 2023-04-24, Jon attended a fair to showcase his dance studio. He found the experience both stressful and great, and got possible business leads. He concluded that running the business was difficult and that self-confidence was important to success. Jon shared a photo of a group of women performing on a stage.

On 2023-04-25, Gina said she had started her own online clothing store not long before. She shared a photo of a laptop displaying a sale advertisement. Jon said he remembered the store and thought it looked great.
Gina said that after losing her job, she started her own business to take control of her destiny. She described the journey as tough but rewarding.

On 2023-04-25, Jon said he was having trouble with his business project and had recently been feeling low in confidence, making it hard to run the business. He asked Gina for advice on staying motivated and confident during difficult times.

Gina advised Jon to stay motivated by keeping his larger goal and reasons for starting in mind, seeking support from people who care about him, and dancing. She suggested building confidence by remembering successes and progress, relying on a good support system, and recalling that Jon started his dance business because he loves dance. Gina affirmed that she believed in Jon.

Jon said Gina's encouragement helped him remember his successes and why he started his business. Jon said that he loves dance and believed that remembering this would help maintain his confidence. He resolved to keep going and pursue his dreams.
On 2023-04-25, Gina and Jon encouraged one another to keep pursuing their goals and said they would continue supporting each other on their respective paths.
On 2023-05-11, Jon said he was still working on his dance studio and that things were looking up. He shared a photo showing a woman wearing a short skirt with her hands on her hips.
On 2023-05-11, Jon said losing his job gave him the push to start his dream business: his own dance studio. He described stepping into the unknown and hoping for the best.
Jon said dance has been his stress-buster since childhood. He said dancing helps him de-stress, makes him feel most alive, is second nature to him, and is essential in his life.
Gina said dance is her stress fix: when she starts dancing, her worries vanish. She said dance feels like air and she cannot picture life without it.

Jon hopes to create a dance studio where people can dance and express themselves. He said owning the studio and teaching others means he is living his dream, and promised to keep Gina updated on the studio's progress.
Gina praised Jon's determination and drive, expressed confidence that his dance studio would succeed and make a difference for many people, and said she was eager to see it happen.
On 2023-05-10, Gina had an interview for a design internship. Gina said the interview went great, but no hiring decision or next step was mentioned.
On 2023-05-11, Gina thanked Jon for keeping her informed about his dance project, called it cool, and said she looked forward to hearing more and watching it come to life.
On 2023-05-11, Jon said taking a risk was scary, but he was sure following his dreams would pay off in the end. Jon was excited about Gina's design internship interview and asked how it went.
On May 11, 2023, Jon said he had been practicing dance routines lately and that dancing kept his mind focused and motivated.
On May 11, 2023, Jon offered to send Gina a video of one of his dance routines and said he would get the video to her soon. Gina said she would watch it and was proud of him.
On May 11, 2023, Gina encouraged Jon's dance practice, said she was always there to help, and looked forward to seeing his dance video.
On 2023-05-27, Gina told Jon she had been accepted for a part-time internship in the fashion department of an international company.
Gina said she felt excited and somewhat nervous or scared about starting her fashion internship, described it as a big change, and hoped to stay upbeat and learn as much as possible.
Gina shared a photo of a laptop computer with a logo on its screen while discussing her internship; the logo was not identified.
Jon shared a photo of a book with a yellow and green cover while asking Gina about her future plans; the book was not identified.

On 2023-05-27, Jon congratulated Gina on her fashion internship and asked where it was and how she felt about it. He later asked about her future plans and whether anything new was happening with her.
On May 27, 2023, Jon said he was reading “The Lean Startup” for tips for his dance business.
On May 27, 2023, Jon said “The Lean Startup” had him thinking about building a focused, efficient business and adapting based on customer feedback; he planned to try those approaches in his business.
On May 27, 2023, Jon shared a photo of a whiteboard with a list of dates. He said the whiteboard helped him track ideas and milestones, visualize his progress, and stay organized.

On May 27, 2023, Jon said he was wrapping up his business plan and looking for investors for his dance business. He said his passion for the project and belief in its success motivated him; finding investors had been difficult, but he remained hopeful and was learning from the process.
On May 27, 2023, Gina praised Jon’s commitment and encouraged him to keep learning and growing while seeking investors.
On May 27, 2023, Jon said he would keep going and never quit on his business efforts. He shared a photo of a pink sign bearing a message, but the message text was not specified.

On 2023-05-27, Gina encouraged Jon to keep going, saying obstacles were inevitable and he could do awesome things. Jon thanked Gina and said her words meant a lot; he promised not to let anything get him down.

On 2023-06-13, Jon told Gina he was preparing for his dance studio more than ever and said opening the studio had been a great experience. He found working with young dancers inspiring and valued their passion and commitment.

Jon wants his dance studio to be a supportive, encouraging place where dancers can grow. Along with dance classes and workshops, he offers one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential.
Gina developed a video presentation teaching how to style her fashion pieces and said she would send it to Jon later. Gina shared a photo of a group of young girls in blue outfits posing together.

Gina said she had a mentor when she was learning to dance and agreed that guidance and support can help dancers shine. Gina shared a photo of a skeleton and a trophy on black cloth, and a photo of a group of people in a dance class. Jon shared a photo of a clipboard with a notepad attached; Gina asked how he had been using it.
Jon thanked Gina for being there for him and believing in him; Gina told Jon she was always around for him and expressed pride in his effort to start his own business.

On 2023-06-13, Jon said he used a notebook calendar to stay organized and motivated, set goals, track his achievements, and identify areas for improvement. A shared photo showed a notebook with a calendar.

On 2023-06-13, Jon said he also used a whiteboard to stay on track, visualize goals, and “tokenize successes”; he said the whiteboard kept him motivated and focused. A shared photo showed a group of markers sitting on a white surface.

Gina and Jon are conversing; surnames and pronouns unknown. Jon left a secure banking job on 2023-01-19 to pursue dance and planned a studio. He values expressive dance spaces, student progress, and joyful performances; began gym around 2023-03-09. Closed a bank account to help the business (2023-04-03); said losing his job led him to dance, which makes him happy and lets him express himself (2023-04-09); recalled younger dance lessons with friends. Showcased dance 2023-04-24. On 2023-05-27, he was reading “The Lean Startup,” applying its focus, efficiency, and customer-feedback ideas; a whiteboard tracked business ideas, milestones, and progress. He was finishing a business plan and seeking investors, finding the search tough but remaining hopeful and determined. On 2023-06-13, Jon said he used a notebook calendar to set goals, track achievements, and identify improvements, and also used a whiteboard to visualize goals and “tokenize successes,” staying motivated and focused. Photos showed the notebook calendar and markers on a white surface.
On 2023-06-13, Jon said he color-codes his achievements to track his progress easily and stay motivated.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo of a cork board with pictures and words on it.
On 2023-06-13, Jon thanked Gina for her encouragement and said his progress-tracking approach helps him stay motivated and reminds him why he is pursuing his goal of building a dance studio.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo showing a person holding a paper bag printed with a picture of a bird and a birdie, and told Jon his idea was great. Jon thanked Gina.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo of a quote on a white sheet illuminated by a rainbow of light and encouraged Jon to stay positive. Jon thanked Gina and said her support had been awesome.
On 2023-06-13, Jon told Gina he would not give up and would keep pushing and working to make his dreams happen; he thanked Gina for her support.
On 2023-06-15, Jon received mentoring from a businessperson he described as an amazing business dude. The experience inspired him and increased his enthusiasm for pursuing his dreams.
On 2023-06-16, Gina said she was growing the customer base for her online clothing store and found the work tough but remained determined.
On 2023-06-16, Jon said he was promoting his business and asked Gina for marketing tips. Gina recommended using social media channels and collaborating with influencers to increase reach.
By 2023-06-16, Jon had begun promoting his business on social media by posting dance videos. Jon said the videos were creating a bit of a stir online.

On 2023-06-16, Gina said she became an entrepreneur after losing her job and opened an online clothing store. She enjoys being her own boss and doing something she loves, and said the change had been a huge but worthwhile leap.

On 2023-06-16, Gina advised Jon to remain passionate, focused, and resilient; believe in himself and persist through challenges; and stay open to learning and improvement. Gina also encouraged Jon not to quit, saying failures bring a person closer to success. Jon said Gina's encouragement motivated him and pledged not to quit.
On 2023-06-16, Gina shared a photo she described as being from when she was dancing. The photo showed a group of young women posing together. Gina said the road had been tough but worthwhile.

On 2023-06-16, Gina shared a photo showing a group of people who looked great and passionate about dancing. Jon said the picture reminded him how much he loved performing and thanked Gina for sharing it.
On 2023-06-16, Jon told Gina he was not giving up on pursuing his dreams and promised he would not let her down. Jon said knowing Gina supported him helped him keep going.
On 2023-06-16, Gina encouraged Jon to keep pursuing his dreams and said she was there for him. Gina described Jon as inspiring because of his determination and passion for dance.
On June 19, 2023, Jon said he had taken a short trip to Rome the previous week to clear his mind while continuing to work on his business.

Jon was working to open a dance studio, whose official opening night and grand opening were scheduled for June 20, 2023. On June 19, Jon was working hard to get everything ready and said he felt good, excited, and ready to do his best after a wild ride.
On June 19, 2023, Jon shared a photo showing a group of young dancers in a dance studio. Gina said the studio looked amazing and congratulated Jon on the work he had put into it.

Jon said he wanted to savor the good feelings at the dance studio's June 20, 2023 grand opening and not forget any moment; he appreciated Gina's support and looked forward to enjoying the occasion with her. Gina said she would be by Jon's side, was proud of him, and would celebrate and make memories with him.

On June 19, 2023, Gina shared a photo showing a group of people in a dance studio. Jon shared a photo showing a man in a native costume giving another man a high five; the conversation did not identify either man or explain the photo's context.

Jon and Gina planned to make memories together at Jon's dance studio grand opening on June 20, 2023. Gina said she loved being around friends and having a great time, and looked forward to having fun at the studio.
Jon's dance studio grand opening is scheduled for June 20, 2023. Gina plans to attend, and Jon and Gina are both excited to celebrate together.
On June 21, 2023, Gina said she had acquired new, unique pieces for her store.
On June 21, 2023, Gina shared a photo of a woman posing in a black hoodie. Gina said the hoodie was from her personal collection and was not for sale.

During the week of June 12–18, 2023, Gina made a limited-edition clothing line to showcase her style and creativity. Gina said making the line was tough but worth it. On June 21, she shared a photo of a camouflage-print hoodie.
On June 21, 2023, Jon congratulated Gina on her store and said he was happy for her. Jon described the hoodie as looking “sick” and asked whether it was a unique piece for sale.
On 2023-06-20, Jon attended networking events to help make progress on his dance business. Jon said networking had been tough but he remained determined and focused.
Jon said that losing his job had made the path difficult, but he believed investing his time in his business would eventually pay off. He appreciated Gina's help and support.
